name: Kanojo ga Kaifuku Mahou o Tonaete Kurenai Riyuu
original_name: 彼女が回復魔法を唱えてくれない理由
source:
A boy and girl attending an adventuring school are torn apart by the
arrival of a new transfer student just as final exams are approaching.

What fate awaits this couple?
There is no escaping the cuckoldry...

Enjoy this NTR story told from two perspectives!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE297258.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
冒险学校的一对少年少女，在期末考试临近之际，因一名新转学生的到来而被拆散。

等待着这对恋人的会是什么命运？
被夺走恋人的结局，无从逃避……

请欣赏这个由两个视角讲述的NTR故事！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE297258.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
